states.changed: First state: every AI chip the open record counts since 2022 as a stream of 2,093 grains through five gates into a basin; seven stakes stand where a law was used (six at the border, each planted after its chips had left, one open ring at the model), three gates stand unread, and a visitor's own hand can close any gate and heap the stream behind it.

The Field's finding of step 2 stands on the gates: 28 acts of eight publics, each in its lane at its date, a bar for a stop, a comb for a delay, a ring for a condition; lifted ones fade, three that were gone around grow a dotted path around the gate, the deal gate reads 'no act found', and the stream runs through every bar because no act's record counts the chips it met.

The check: the acts are the Field's checked coding (11 stops, 7 delays, 10 conditions; one export rule thinned as loosened in part), marks three times larger, an empty dotted box after every mark for the chips it met and the word for what it met in its own unit, holes punched in standing stops by the passing grains, a row of bars counting what became of the stops, the Virginia floor ceiling as a dotted circle, the uncounted months hatched, and a section on what was checked, held and corrected.
